Any reason to add this as a field to the new `LayoutConfig` struct, as opposed to a newtype struct (or enum) specifically for this purpose? Do we expect more layout options to be configurable soon?

> Sad to add a branch here, but the use case in the linked issue is very reasonable.

Yeah taffy's rounding api is really unpleasant with how this setting is used both to enable or disable rounding during updates, and then afterwards to access the unrounded values. I'll make a taffy PR as well with some alternative then we'd be able to clean this up too later.

> Any reason to add this as a field to the new `LayoutConfig` struct, as opposed to a newtype struct (or enum) specifically for this purpose? Do we expect more layout options to be configurable soon?

I'm not really sure. I'm not against using an enum or an `UnroundedLayout` marker component or something instead. I guess I think if we did have any other similar niche configuration options it'd be preferable to consolidate them together in a single struct like this for the sake of discoverability. If there were other settings we'd have to add an inherit from parent option to the `use_rounding` setting.

issue_context.title: Bevy UI nodes are always pixel-aligned and there is no way to disable it
comments: Hmm. I see your point. I'm not sure where the best place to expose a setting for this would be. @ickshonpe may have ideas.
Yep this isn't difficult to expose. It would have to be a per-root-node setting I think.
It would be great if this could be defined on any node and have it apply to that node and all nodes down the tree, but I guess that’s technically not possible?

> It would be great if this could be defined on any node and have it apply to that node and all nodes down the tree, but I guess that’s technically not possible?

Nope I ended up implementing the per-node setting, it was easier. I had some vague concerns with mixing up unrounded and rounded layouts but they probably aren't worth worring about. 

The other problem with the per-node approach is that generating a rounded layout is more expensive as it walks the layout tree a second time. With a per-root approach you can skip generating the rounded layout.

review_comments: This is potentially leaky if the `self.taffy.layout(..)` errors-out. It seems this function should always end with rounding enabled.

Yeah this function is fine I think as this is the only place we read the layout values and we reset the rounding mode each time we enter it, but we need to call `enable_rounding()` each frame before we recompute the layout since like you say the update walk could end with `disable_rounding` set.

> Yeah this function is fine I think as this is the only place we read the layout values and we reset the rounding mode each time we enter it

Imo this reasoning is too fragile. It assumes the current design will stay the same, and it implies if the design does change that whoever changes it will somehow know the right thing to do.

For this function to be correct, it needs to leave the taffy layout in a correct state in all circumstances.
